title: PrairieRx Plans and the Eligibility Categories They Serve
content:
The Pharmacy Benefit of Prairie Ridge Health Plan is held as one of seven PrairieRx plans. The table below lists, for each plan, the plan eligibility categories whose members hold it, any further entry condition the plan carries, and whether Medicare Part D pays first on that plan.

| PrairieRx plan | Plan eligibility categories served | Further entry condition | Medicare Part D pays first |
|---|---|---|---|
| PrairieRx Dual Wrap | Prairie Ridge Dual Complete | The member is enrolled in Medicare Part D | Yes |
| PrairieRx Expansion Adult | Prairie Ridge Expansion Adult | None | No |
| PrairieRx Adult | Prairie Ridge Family Care | None | No |
| PrairieRx Children | Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids; Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid | None | No |
| PrairieRx Maternity | Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | None | No |
| PrairieRx Complex Care | Prairie Ridge ABD Care | None | No |
| PrairieRx Long-Term Care | None listed; the plan rests on nursing facility residence instead of a category | The member is a nursing facility resident with an LTSS Service Coordination care enrollment | No |

### Reading the table

- **Categories served** is the list of official plan eligibility categories mapped to the plan. PrairieRx Children is the only plan that serves two categories.
- **PrairieRx Long-Term Care** has an empty category list: membership in it follows from nursing facility residence together with an LTSS Service Coordination care enrollment, not from the category on the membership.
- **Medicare Part D pays first** is marked Yes for PrairieRx Dual Wrap alone; on every other PrairieRx plan the Pharmacy Benefit is not secondary to Part D.

### Points of reference

*Which categories map to PrairieRx Children?* Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids and Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid.

*Which plan lists Medicare Part D enrollment as an entry condition?* PrairieRx Dual Wrap, which serves the Prairie Ridge Dual Complete category.
